messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tirzepatide carries a Boxed Warning for the risk of possible thyroid tumors.
Possible Thyroid Tumors (Including Cancer):
Tell your healthcare provider if you get a lump or swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath.
These may be symptoms of thyroid cancer.
In studies with rats, tirzepatide and medicines that work like tirzepatide have caused thyroid tumors.
These tumors include thyroid cancer.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause thyroid tumors.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause medullary thyroid carcinoma.
Medullary thyroid carcinoma is a type of thyroid cancer.
This applies to people.
Do not use tirzepatide if you or any of your family have ever had a type of thyroid cancer called medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC).
Do not use tirzepatide if you have an endocrine system condition called Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has study finding", "causes thyroid tumors in rats"]

The relation 'has study finding' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has been found in studies to have the effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'has animal study result': The subject drug has been associated with the finding or outcome specified by the object entity in animal studies.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
E. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
F. None of the above.
